title: Crypto Trading Signals - August 12, 2026
top_story_headline: Mercury Spend launches team and AI agent cards with budgets, automated receipt matching and policy controls, letting companies manage spending without adding finance overhead
top_story_comment: Card rails are compressing crypto’s agent-payments moat: [Corpay launched controlled virtual cards for AI agents on July 28](https://www.corpay.com/corporate-newsroom/20326/corpay-introduces-agent-card-capability-to-power-secure-agentic-commerce). Crypto’s edge shifts to portable identity via ERC-8004 and open settlement via x402; [Mercury’s hosted MCP remains read-only and cannot initiate transactions](https://docs.mercury.com/docs/security-best-practices).
